post.caption: She wouldn't look at the ring. In 2002, Ben Affleck proposed to Jennifer Lopez with a pink diamond from Harry Winston. The center stone weighs 6.1 carats and is a fancy intense pink radiant cut, with two white diamonds beside it. She told Diane Sawyer she could tell it was pink, so she avoided looking at it, and then called it the most magnificent thing. Many credit the ring with sparking interest in colored diamonds.
